			<article class="post-265 page type-page status-publish hentry" id="post-265">
				<div class="post-inner">

					<div class="entry-content">

						
<div class="wp-block-cover alignfull is-light"><img decoding="async" width="939" height="621" sizes="(max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 939px) 100vw, 939px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-293 size-full" alt="" src="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-Room-23-1.jpg" data-object-fit="cover" srcset="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-Room-23-1.jpg 939w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-Room-23-1-300x198.jpg 300w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-Room-23-1-768x508.jpg 768w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-Room-23-1-24x16.jpg 24w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-Room-23-1-36x24.jpg 36w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Punta-Trettu-Kitesurf-Room-23-1-48x32.jpg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim wp-block-cover__gradient-background has-background-gradient" style="background-color:#c6c3c0;background:linear-gradient(45deg,rgb(29,32,72) 0%,rgb(41,92,132) 100%)"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Private Suites at Punta Trettu: Comfort, Privacy, and Independence: Not a Hotel Room. Your Private Suite.</h2>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-a89b3969 wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-white-background-color has-background wp-element-button" href="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/prices">rates</a></div>



<div class="wp-block-button is-style-outline is-style-outline--2"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-white-color has-text-color wp-element-button" href="https://kitegeneration.com/kiteform">Book Now</a></div>
</div>
</div></div>



<p>While <strong>The Punta Trettu Villa</strong> is designed for communal living and shared adventures, we know that a great holiday starts with a great night’s sleep. Our rooms are not just bedrooms; they are <strong>independent suites</strong> designed to offer every guest maximum privacy and a quiet retreat after a high-energy day on the water.</p>



<p>Whether you are part of a large kite crew, a family, or a group of friends, our room layout ensures that everyone has their own &#8220;private corner&#8221; within the estate.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Not a Hotel Room. <em>Your Private Suite.</em></h2>



<p>There are no corridors connecting the rooms. There is no lobby. There is no reception. When you arrive at your room, you step directly from the garden — from the Sardinian air — into your own private space. You enter with your personal door code. Nobody else has it.</p>



<p>This is the essential difference between Punta Trettu Kitesurf House and everywhere else. Every room is an independent unit: a self-contained suite that opens onto the outside world, not into a shared hallway. Your space begins the moment you step through your armoured door. The Feature That Changes Everything</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Your Own Door. <em>Your Own Code.</em></h2>



<p>Every room has an independent armoured entrance door that opens directly to the outside — no corridors, no shared hallways, no passing through common areas. You come and go exactly as you please.</p>



<div class="wp-block-cover alignfull is-light"><img decoding="async" width="939" height="623" sizes="(max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 939px) 100vw, 939px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-298 size-full" alt="" src="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8.jpg" data-object-fit="cover" srcset="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8.jpg 939w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-300x199.jpg 300w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-768x510.jpg 768w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-24x16.jpg 24w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-36x24.jpg 36w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-48x32.jpg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim wp-block-cover__gradient-background has-background-gradient" style="background-color:#c2bfbb;background:linear-gradient(45deg,rgb(29,32,72) 0%,rgb(41,92,132) 100%)"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Designed for the Modern Travelers</h2>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-a89b3969 wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-white-background-color has-background wp-element-button" href="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/prices">rates</a></div>



<div class="wp-block-button is-style-outline is-style-outline--3"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-white-color has-text-color wp-element-button" href="https://kitegeneration.com/kiteform">Book Now</a></div>
</div>
</div></div>



<p>Every room in the villa has been thoughtfully renovated to meet the needs of kitesurfers and active travelers:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Total Independence:</strong> Every suite features its own <strong>private external entrance</strong>. You can come and go as you please—whether for an early sunrise session or a late-night walk—without disturbing the rest of the group.</li>



<li><strong>Ensuite Bathrooms:</strong> No shared facilities. Each room is equipped with its own <strong>private bathroom</strong> and high-pressure shower, providing the comfort and hygiene you expect from a premium property.</li>



<li><strong>Smart Climate Control:</strong> All rooms feature <strong>Smart Wi-Fi Air Conditioning and Heating</strong>. This allows for personalized temperature settings in every room, ensuring a perfect climate for recovery, regardless of the weather outside.</li>



<li><strong>Superior Rest:</strong> We provide high-quality mattresses and linens to guarantee the deep sleep necessary to recharge your muscles for another day of kiting.</li>
</ul>



<div class="wp-block-cover alignfull is-light"><img decoding="async" width="939" height="623" sizes="(max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 939px) 100vw, 939px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-298 size-full" alt="" src="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8.jpg" data-object-fit="cover" srcset="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8.jpg 939w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-300x199.jpg 300w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-768x510.jpg 768w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-24x16.jpg 24w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-36x24.jpg 36w, https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kitesurf-room-23-8-48x32.jpg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim wp-block-cover__gradient-background has-background-gradient" style="background-color:#c2bfbb;background:linear-gradient(45deg,rgb(29,32,72) 0%,rgb(41,92,132) 100%)"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Room Amenities at a Glance</h2>



<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-a89b3969 wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-white-background-color has-background wp-element-button" href="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/prices">rates</a></div>



<div class="wp-block-button is-style-outline is-style-outline--4"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-white-color has-text-color wp-element-button" href="https://kitegeneration.com/kiteform">Book Now</a></div>
</div>
</div></div>



<p>To make your stay effortless, every suite is equipped with:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>High-Speed Wi-Fi:</strong> Reliable connectivity throughout the room for remote work or streaming.</li>



<li><strong>Dedicated Storage:</strong> Ample space for your personal luggage and clothes.</li>



<li><strong>Outdoor Sitting Area:</strong> Each room opens up to a portion of the garden or patio, perfect for a morning coffee in the fresh Sardinian air.</li>



<li><strong>Smart Hot Water System:</strong> Our intelligent boiler ensures that every guest enjoys a hot shower, even when the whole group returns from the beach at the same time. </li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">More Than Just a Room</h2>



<p>By staying in our rooms, you gain full, exclusive access to the entire <strong>Punta Trettu Kitesurf House</strong> ecosystem:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>The <strong>Professional Kitchen</strong> for your group meals.</li>



<li>The <strong>Private Swimming Pool</strong> and sun-drenched solarium.</li>



<li>The <strong>Kite-Friendly Zone</strong> with outdoor showers and gear storage.</li>



<li>The <strong>Expansive Garden</strong> and shaded verandas for total relaxation.</li>
</ul>
